body:
Hey, I finally got the updated renders from the contractor this afternoon. He sent three layout options for the kitchen - the island configuration, the galley style, and the one with the peninsula we talked about last weekend. I've gone through them quickly but honestly I'm second-guessing myself on the cabinet colors and the countertop pairing.

Could you take a look when you have a few minutes tonight? I want to send feedback back to him by Thursday so we can lock in the order before prices go up again. I'll leave the folder on the desktop if you want to look on the big monitor.
snippet: Hey, I finally got the updated renders from the contractor this afternoon. He se...
subject: Design review request - kitchen renovation renders

body:
Just looked through all three. Honestly the peninsula layout is still my favorite - it flows so much better into the dining area and we'd actually use the extra seating. The island is beautiful but I think it would feel cramped once you factor in the fridge clearance.

On the colors: I think the warm white cabinets with the quartz in Option B is the strongest combo. The dark cabinets in Option C look great in the render but I feel like they'd make the space feel smaller, especially in the morning light. Can you ask him if the warm white comes in a matte finish? That detail matters to me.

Otherwise I think we're in good shape to move forward. Let me know what he says.
snippet: Just looked through all three. Honestly the peninsula layout is still my favorit...
subject: Re: Design review request - kitchen renovation renders

body:
Good call on the peninsula - I came around to the same conclusion after sleeping on it. And I actually agree about the dark cabinets now that you mention the morning light thing. We do get a lot of east-facing sun in there.

I messaged the contractor and he confirmed the warm white is available in matte, no upcharge. He also mentioned there's a slightly warmer off-white option called 'Linen' that might pair even better with the quartz we picked. He's going to email a swatch photo tomorrow. Want to wait for that before I give him the final go-ahead, or are you comfortable enough to confirm now?

I'm leaning toward waiting just one more day so we can be sure.
snippet: Good call on the peninsula - I came around to the same conclusion after sleeping...
subject: Re: Design review request - kitchen renovation renders

body:
Yes, let's wait for the Linen swatch - one extra day is worth it for something we'll be looking at every morning for the next ten years. If it reads too yellow in the photo we'll stick with the warm white and move on.

Go ahead and confirm everything else with him though so we're not holding up the timeline on the structural stuff. Cabinet color is the only open question at this point.

Thanks for tracking all of this, by the way. I know you've been doing most of the back-and-forth with him and I really appreciate it.
snippet: Yes, let's wait for the Linen swatch - one extra day is worth it for something w...
subject: Re: Design review request - kitchen renovation renders

Hey, I finally looked into the train from Porto to Lisbon and the 11:20 departure works best - gets us in by 1pm so we have the afternoon. I went ahead and checked the Airbnb we were looking at in Alfama and it's still available for those three nights. Should I book it, or do you want to look at it first?

Also, do you want to rent a car at all or just use transit the whole time? I'm thinking transit is fine for the city, but if we want to do Sintra properly we might need one for at least a day.

 -  Matthias

subject: Trip to Lisbon - logistics

body:

For Sintra I think a rental for one day makes sense. We could do it on the Thursday and just take the train back into the city that evening. Can you check what the rental options look like near the Porto airport or do we pick it up in Lisbon?

 -  Joyce

body:
Booked! It does have AC, and the reviews mention the host is really responsive. Check-in is flexible so we can drop bags early if the train gets us there before 2.

I looked at rentals and it's actually cheaper and easier to pick up in Lisbon - there's an Enterprise right near Rossio station. I'll book a compact for Thursday only. Should be around 45 euros for the day with insurance.

One more thing: do you want to do a dinner reservation somewhere on the first night or keep it loose?

 -  Matthias

But maybe book somewhere for Saturday night since that's our last real evening. I've been looking at a place called Taberna da Rua das Flores, apparently you need a reservation well in advance.

 -  Joyce

Dear Joyce, the digitisation team has finished cataloguing the first batch for Phase 2 and I wanted to flag a scheduling question before Friday's board update. Petra's conservators need the Klimt drawings back in the store by the end of next week, so if we want them photographed at high resolution we should book the imaging studio for this Thursday and Friday.

Could you confirm the studio budget line under the EU heritage grant is still open? I'd rather not slip the milestone. I've asked Beatrix to prepare the object list either way.

Let me know if Thursday works or if we should push to the following week. - Stefan

subject: Digitisation Phase 2 - imaging studio scheduling

body:
Thursday and Friday work well, Stefan - please go ahead and book the imaging studio. The budget line is still open; I confirmed with Christoph that the grant tranche covers the high-resolution photography, so we are on solid ground for the milestone.

One request: could the team prioritise the Schiele sheets as well while everything is set up? Margarethe will want those images for the Vienna Modern catalogue. I'd feel much better going into the board update with a clean first batch behind us.

Thank you for keeping this on track. - Joyce
snippet: Thursday and Friday work well, Stefan - please go ahead and book the imaging st...
subject: Re: Digitisation Phase 2 - imaging studio scheduling

body:
Perfect - studio booked for Thursday and Friday, and I've asked Beatrix to add the Schiele sheets to the object list. Petra is happy as long as everything is back in the store by Friday evening, which the schedule allows.

I'll send you the first proofs over the weekend so you and Margarethe can review before the board update. If the batch is clean I think we're in very good shape for the milestone. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

 -  Stefan
